outcome: Incidence of oxygen desaturation after cesarean delivery
cohort: 324 healthy, term parturients undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: The incidence of postoperative oxygen desaturation in healthy parturients undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia was uncommon (0.3%).
mod_finding: The incidence of oxygen desaturation after cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia was uncommon.
